trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated:** The latest production deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions. (v2.3.1-rc was healthy only in staging, not production, so it wasn't eligible.)
3. **Verified:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, with the error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
4. **Opened incident:** Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the v2.3.1 deployment failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and post-rollback health confirmation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation before it can be re-released.
